full_prompt_en: A square muted-color illustration shows a young figure from the chest upward before an intricately drawn bird's-eye city. The figure occupies the center, turning the face toward the left and looking past the frame with a calm, attentive expression. A soft dark cap rests over light brown hair, with large oval goggles set on the crown rather than over the eyes. The hair is gathered into a low braid that descends along the right shoulder. Pale skin and clear blue eyes are modeled smoothly, in marked contrast to the fine linework behind. A white high-collared shirt and loosely tied dark neck ribbon sit beneath a deep blue-gray tailored jacket; small folds and button-like details are described with restrained lines. The city background is an almost continuous web of sepia streets, roofs, blocks, and tiny clustered marks, viewed from far above. A pale waterway or broad open strip cuts through the left middle, giving the dense map a little breathing room. The figure is sharply separated from the city by scale and softer modeling, yet the hair and costume share the background's antique brown-gray tone. Fine paper grain and lightly aged color wash cover the image. The viewpoint on the figure is near eye level, while the background is an aerial drawing, creating a deliberate layered perspective. Diffuse light from the upper left gently brightens the face and cap, leaving the jacket darker and the city evenly lit without strong cast shadows. No readable text is present. The overall composition feels reflective and old-fashioned, balancing a simple central silhouette against the crowded, delicate city pattern.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形低调彩色插画呈现一位年轻人物的胸部以上形象，背景是一座绘得极细的鸟瞰城市。人物居中，脸朝左转，平静而留心地看向画框外。柔软深色帽子压着浅棕头发，硕大椭圆护目镜放在帽顶，而不是盖住眼睛。头发束成低辫，沿右肩垂下。浅色皮肤与清亮蓝眼睛得到平滑塑形，和身后的细线条形成明显对照。白色高领衬衣与松松系着的深色领结位于深蓝灰剪裁外套之下；小褶痕和似纽扣细节以克制线条描述。城市背景几乎是一整张赭色街道、屋顶、街区与微小密集痕迹的网，从很高处俯看。一条浅色水道或宽阔开敞带从左侧中部切过，给密集图样留下些许呼吸。人物因尺度与较柔软的塑形而从城市中锐利分离，头发与服装却分享背景的古旧棕灰色调。细纸纹与轻微老化的色洗覆盖画面。人物视点近乎平视，而背景是航拍式绘图，形成有意的层叠透视。左上方散射光轻轻打亮脸与帽子，外套较深，城市则均匀受光，没有强烈投影。没有可读文字。整体构图沉思且带旧时气息，以简单中央剪影平衡繁忙细巧的城市图案。
style_prompt_en: The image has a softly painted illustration finish over fine sepia draftsmanship and lightly aged paper grain. Smooth pale focal planes meet a background of minute interlocking lines, giving close detail and distant detail very different densities. Cool slate blue, warm beige, muted umber, cream, and small clear blue accents form a restrained palette. Edges are gently modeled near the focal shape but multiply into delicate hatching across the surrounding field. Broad diffuse light leaves no hard shadow, allowing fine texture and subtle tonal shifts to remain visible. A large simple silhouette anchors a dense patterned backdrop, with scale contrast doing more work than color contrast. The overall effect is wistful, precise, and quietly imaginative, joining clear form to an almost map-like web of marks.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有柔和绘成的插画完成面，覆于细密赭色制图线条和轻微老化的纸纹之上。平滑浅色焦点平面与由微小互锁线条构成的背景相遇，让近处细节与远处细节具有不同密度。冷石板蓝、暖米色、低调赭棕、奶油色和少量清蓝强调组成克制色域。焦点形状附近边缘柔和塑形，周围区域则增殖为纤细排线。宽阔散射光不留下硬影，使细纹理和微妙色调变化仍能显现。大而简单的剪影稳住密集花纹背景，尺度反差比色彩反差承担更多作用。整体效果怀旧、精确且安静富想象力，让清楚形体与近似地图的笔迹网络相接。
theme_en: A young figure in an aviator cap before a finely drawn sepia city
theme_zh: 一位戴飞行员帽的年轻人站在细描的赭色城市前
name: Tsuguharu Foujita
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
